findings.title: History can prefer an old training manifest over a newer collection-off retry
Your Voice can count multiple transcriptions of one capture as multiple dictations
Historical dictionary use is rendered using the entry’s current spelling
Recovery Copy Last Raw bypasses pending clipboard-paste ownership
Torn-schema repair can erase governance links while leaving a current private profile
A late Export refresh can overwrite a completed Validate result
Export Validate runs potentially large filesystem work on the Hub callback
Export rename and database completion commit need crash reconciliation
Approved learning rules have service Undo but no Hub Undo Approval control
Current STATUS fields still describe implementation-era M14 behavior and timings
The central verification runbook has no M07 checks despite carried qualification work
